name: Pickup technical with Type 63 107 mm rocket launcher
armament: Type 63 12-tube 107 mm rocket launcher (or copies such as the Iranian HM-20 / Fadjr-1) in the bed
protection: Unarmoured pickup. Game rule treats the vehicle body as immune to small-calibre, but 7.62x54R and up penetrate; crew exposed. In game the launcher fires as an off-map or shoot-and-scoot event, and the launch site is a contract objective.
visual_notes: Boxy 12-tube launcher (3 rows of 4) on a turntable in the bed
Hilux or Land Cruiser pickup chassis; tarpaulin cover when moving
Scorched paint behind the tubes, launch smoke and dust as an effect
